name: Montserrat Remote Worker Stamp

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a non-national employed by, or partnered/shareholding in, a company registered and operating outside Montserrat, or a freelancer/consultant serving primarily foreign clients.
Minimum annual income of US$70,000 derived from outside Montserrat.
requirements.fix_path: Increase and document qualifying foreign-sourced income to at least US$70,000/year.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract, partnership/shareholder proof, or freelance/consulting client documentation
Fee: US$500 (single applicant), US$750 (family up to 3 dependants), US$250 per additional dependant (non-refundable)

sources.title: Government of Montserrat, Ministry of Communication Works, Labour & Energy -- Montserrat Remote Worker Stamp: eligibility, income threshold, fees, 12-month duration (site explicitly copyrighted to the Government of Montserrat, contact listed as the named Ministry, despite the non-.gov.ms domain)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Montserrat's initial build. The program's official site sits on a non-government-TLD domain (montserratremoteworker.com) rather than gov.ms -- flagged explicitly, but treated as tier-1 because the page itself states 'Copyright (c) 2026 - The Government of Montserrat' and names the Ministry of Communication Works, Labour & Energy as the operating authority, the same pattern used earlier this session for Dominica's windominica.gov.dm (a dedicated official program domain rather than the general government portal). work_rights is 'restricted': the stamp authorises remote work for the foreign employer/clients only, not local Montserrat employment. No stated path to permanent residence or citizenship.
